textures.title: CGI Moon Kit, colour map (2025 version, 2,048 x 1,024)
textures.credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, from Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter camera and laser altimeter data
textures.nature: A visualisation built from LRO data and "optimized for aesthetics, not science" (NASA's words).

textures.title: Cassini's Best Maps of Jupiter, cylindrical map (PIA07782)
textures.nature: Cassini-derived cylindrical global map of Jupiter (built from Cassini images of 11-12 December 2000), covering 360° of longitude and ±90° planetocentric latitude. The polar regions are less clearly visible. Colours are close to those the human eye would see, but not strictly true colour.
